name: Taifa of Morón
alt: Taifa of Morón de la Frontera

predecessors.name: Caliphate of Córdoba
predecessors.text: the district of Morón, Cliopatria's 1,288 km2 shape (a circle of about 20 km)

successors.name: Taifa of Seville
successors.text: Cliopatria's second Morón shape, identical to the first

ledger.x: 1010: the taifa of Morón arises as the Caliphate of Córdoba falls.
1066: the taifa of Morón ends under Manad (1057-1066); the land passes to Seville (see the loss event).

wars.name: Seville's conquest of Morón
wars.outcome: Seville conquered Morón in 1066 and held it until the Almoravids took Seville in 1091.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary, a town list or an area; the circle round Morón is Cliopatria's.
